Membership Mixer: Veramendi - The Ledge

Thursday, October 15, 2026 (5:30 PM - 7:30 PM) (CDT)

Description

The October membership mixer will be held at Veramendi - The Ledge! Join us for mingling with fellow Chamber members, cold beverages, door prize drawings, and more. We will be drawing for a cash prize, but remember in order to win you must be present! Be sure to bring your membership card. Don’t miss the chance to meet other Chamber members, network with business and community leaders, and make new connections. Thank you to Veramendi for putting on this month's membership mixer!

Additional Info

2164 Oak Run Pkwy
New Braunfels, 78132
